ReleaseCataloguePanel.title: Agent release catalogue
ReleaseCataloguePanel.scope: Read-only observations. Recorded URLs, checksums and signatures are metadata, not proof of safe content or permission to mutate a release. Downloads start only after an explicit request, and the server checks access again.
ReleaseCataloguePanel.empty: No matching releases on this page.
ReleaseCataloguePanel.url: Recorded download URL (not opened or verified)
ReleaseCataloguePanel.pagination: Newest first. Each page is a separate observation; releases can change between pages. Load the first page to start again. This is not a complete inventory or a stable snapshot.

notices.initial: Choose filters and load a page. No request has been issued.
notices.failed: The catalogue could not be confirmed. No rows are shown. Check the current account and load again explicitly; no automatic retry was made.
notices.cancelled: Catalogue load cancelled locally. No rows were retained. Cancellation is not proof that the server stopped processing.
notices.contextChanged: Account context changed. Previous rows and filters were cleared. Load a new page explicitly.
notices.filterChanged: Filters changed. Previous rows were cleared; load a page to apply these filters.
notices.loaded: Validated catalogue observation. Server authority is checked again for any later operation.

downloadNotices.requested: Download requested from the authenticated server. The browser controls the transfer and save; this page cannot confirm completion or cancel an already requested download. Unknown or external-only artifacts may be refused.
downloadNotices.unconfirmed: The download could not be confirmed. Review the current account and server response before explicitly trying again; no retry was automatic.

ReleasePromotionWorkflow.title: Mark an agent release as latest
ReleasePromotionWorkflow.scope: Select a release UUID from a freshly loaded catalogue. The server verifies its current signature and authority before changing latest for its organization, platform and agent type. This action does not publish, delete or download a release.
ReleasePromotionWorkflow.confirmation: Type the complete selected UUID to confirm
ReleasePromotionWorkflow.observedTarget: Platform and agent type in the response
ReleasePromotionWorkflow.acknowledgement: I have kept the selected release UUID and understand that closing does not cancel or roll back a server change. After an uncertain result I must inspect the current catalogue before deciding whether another action is needed.

notices.initial: No promotion has been prepared or requested.
notices.prepared: Prepared locally. No request has been sent. Confirm the UUID to issue one promotion attempt.
notices.invalid: Preparation was refused. Check the UUID and current account permissions. No request was sent.
notices.working: One promotion attempt is in progress. No automatic retry will occur.
notices.notIssued: The request was refused before dispatch. Close this local workflow and review the current account before deliberately preparing a new action.
notices.unconfirmed: The promotion outcome is unconfirmed. Keep the selected UUID and inspect the current catalogue. Do not assume rollback or automatically retry.
notices.confirmed: A valid promotion response was received for this UUID. This is an observation, not independent signature verification or a promise that it is still latest. Reload the catalogue to inspect current state.
notices.cancelled: Stopped waiting locally. An issued request may still have committed. Keep the selected UUID and inspect the current catalogue before another action.
notices.contextChanged: Account context changed; local details were cleared. An earlier request may still have committed. Inspect only under your current authority.
notices.closed: Local workflow closed. Earlier server actions and uncertain outcomes are unchanged.

ReleasePublicationWorkflow.title: Prepare a new agent release
ReleasePublicationWorkflow.scope: Preparation is local. It does not upload, reserve, sign, publish, or verify an external URL. Publication requires a retained intent, exact review, and current server authorization.
ReleasePublicationWorkflow.organizationHelp: The target is explicit metadata, not an authorization grant.
ReleasePublicationWorkflow.notesHelp: Up to20,000 Unicode code points; the complete value is validated before preparation.
ReleasePublicationWorkflow.signingHelp: Latest publication requires a trusted signing identity. Preparation does not check or change signing configuration.
ReleasePublicationWorkflow.verifyBytes: The server independently verifies the uploaded bytes.
ReleasePublicationWorkflow.checksumHelp: Enter64 lowercase hexadecimal characters from your release artifact. The URL is not fetched.
ReleasePublicationWorkflow.locked: The form is locked to keep it separate from the retained operation below. Close the local workflow explicitly before preparing another release.
ReleasePublicationWorkflow.acknowledgement: I have kept any original intent needed for recovery and understand that closing this view does not cancel or roll back a server operation.

notices.contextChanged: Account context changed. Local input was cleared. Any earlier server request may still have committed; retain and reopen its original intent.
notices.prepared: Intent prepared locally. Use it below, save and verify the original document, then review it with the server. No release request has been issued.
notices.failed: Intent preparation did not complete. Check the fields, file, and account context. No release request was issued by preparation.
notices.closed: Local workflow closed. Retained server operations and any uncertain outcomes are unchanged. Reopen the original intent to inspect them.

ReleaseDeletionWorkflow.title: Prepare agent release deletion
ReleaseDeletionWorkflow.scope: Enter the release UUID from the catalogue. Preparation reads the current target; it does not reserve an operation, remove a release, or delete any bytes. The retained intent must be reviewed again before an explicit action.
ReleaseDeletionWorkflow.locked: The target is locked to the retained operation below. Close local state explicitly before selecting another release. Existing saved intents can also be reopened below.
ReleaseDeletionWorkflow.acknowledgement: I have kept any original intent needed for recovery and understand that closing this view does not cancel or roll back a server operation.

notices.contextChanged: Account context changed. Local input was cleared. Earlier server operations may still have committed; reopen their original saved intents.
notices.prepared: Deletion intent prepared from a read-only server observation. Nothing was reserved, deleted, or cleaned up. Save and verify the original intent below, then review it again before choosing an action.
notices.failed: Deletion preparation did not complete. Check the selected release and current account. Preparation sent no mutation and will not retry automatically.
notices.closed: Local deletion workflow closed. Server operations and uncertain outcomes are unchanged. Reopen the original saved intent to inspect them.

ReleaseIntentRecoveryPanel.title: Release intent and recovery
ReleaseIntentRecoveryPanel.retentionHelp: Keep the original intent file in a secure location. It may contain private release metadata. File readback confirms its contents now; it is not a backup or future disk-survival guarantee.
ReleaseIntentRecoveryPanel.authorityHelp: Requests run only when you select an action. Cancelling a request cannot undo a server commit. Historical results never grant future authority.
ReleaseIntentRecoveryPanel.expired: The account context changed or this session expired. Reopen the saved intent and review it again. Do not infer that any earlier request was rolled back.
ReleaseIntentRecoveryPanel.verified: Matching intent file read back and verified. Keep your saved copy.
ReleaseIntentRecoveryPanel.downloadIssued: Download initiated. Select the saved file below to verify it; download dispatch does not confirm a save.
ReleaseIntentRecoveryPanel.saveRequired: Save the original intent and select the saved file for verification before mutation.
ReleaseIntentRecoveryPanel.reviewRequired: Review the exact retained intent with the server before choosing a mutation.
ReleaseIntentRecoveryPanel.noHistory: No operation history was observed. This does not prove rollback or authorize cleanup. Only an explicit reservation request is available, subject to fresh server checks.
ReleaseIntentRecoveryPanel.uncertain: A mutation outcome is unconfirmed. Inspect retained operation history before another mutation. Missing history requires recovery investigation.
ReleaseIntentRecoveryPanel.binaryHelp: The server must verify the exact binary size and checksum. File selection is not verification.
ReleaseIntentRecoveryPanel.confirmation: Type the complete operation ID to confirm this action
ReleaseIntentRecoveryPanel.observationHelp: This is not a current authorization or an instruction to retry.

errors.generic: The operation could not be confirmed. Keep the original intent and inspect before another mutation.
errors.notIssued: Release request was not issued. Review the current account and original intent.
errors.unconfirmed: Release outcome is unconfirmed. Retain the original intent and inspect the same operation before deciding what to do.
errors.file: The intent file could not be verified. This file action did not send a release request.

AgentReleasesWorkspace.title: Agent releases
AgentReleasesWorkspace.description: Load current release observations, then explicitly prepare, recover or promote a release.
AgentReleasesWorkspace.retention: Collapsing a section preserves its local workflow. Leaving this page or changing account clears local presentation; it does not cancel server operations. Keep every original intent required for recovery.
